visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short, neat black hair is shown from the head and shoulders up. He wears a plain white crew-neck T-shirt and has white over-ear headphones on his head. His facial expression is animated, mouth moving as he speaks, and he glances to the right side of the frame. The background is a clean, modern indoor setting with light grey and off-white vertical panels. Yellow and white text overlays are visible in the foreground. (2) The man holds the white headphones in both hands, bringing them close to the camera. His fingers grip the headband and the square-shaped earcups, which feature transparent outer covers showing internal electronic components and circular grey elements. He rotates the headphones to show different angles, highlighting the sleek, minimalist aesthetic. (3) He holds the white headphones in one hand and a pair of beige, oval-shaped headphones in the other for direct comparison. His hands move back and forth to emphasize the difference in ear cup shape—square versus oval. He points with his right index finger to the transparent casing of the white headphones. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the side profile of the white headphones held in his hand. A small grey dial and a rectangular button are visible on the side of the transparent ear cup. A white graphic arrow with a thin outline points toward the dial, indicating its function. (5) The man wears the white headphones again, looking directly at the camera with a slight smile and a nod. He adjusts the headband with both hands, demonstrating the fit. The lighting remains bright studio quality, and the background remains a consistent neutral indoor setting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這絕對是我近期看過. [Slogan]: 透明頭戴耳機 Nothing Headphone 1. [Variety]: 造型最特別的耳機🎧. (2) [Subtitle]: 各位在我手上的就是 Nothing 它們家出的最新耳機. (3) [Subtitle]: 叫 Nothing Headphone (1). 這個造型非常非常的酷. (4) [Subtitle]: 像主流都是這種橢圓形的造型. 但 Nothing 它們家出的是這種方形. (5) [Subtitle]: 最特別的是它這邊側面的耳罩. 做的是透明的. 有一點點像是透明的卡帶. (6) [Subtitle]: 就很復古. 路上直接一就看就知道. 這是 Nothing 他們家的耳機. (7) [Subtitle]: 這個耳機除了造型非常酷之外. 重點是它的按鈕也跟一般耳機不太一樣. (8) [Subtitle]: 你看這邊有一個滾輪它可以轉. 就是音量的大小聲. 按一下就是暫停. (9) [Subtitle]: 這一邊又有另外一個實體按鈕. 往前往後就是下一首歌, 上一首歌. (10) [Subtitle]: 那我試用了一下. 它的這個耳罩其實在佩戴感受上非常的不錯. (11) [Subtitle]: 它整體戴起來呢, 是比 XM4, XM5 的這個耳罩還要再更 Q 彈一點點. (12) [Subtitle]: 但貼合度也很好. 主動降噪的效果也非常不錯. (13) [Subtitle]: 那最重要的當然還是音質. 它這一次的耳機單體呢. (14) [Subtitle]: 是跟一個很有名的音響廠商叫 KEF 合作. (15) [Subtitle]: 音質大概介於 XM4 到 XM5 左右. (16) [Subtitle]: 目前 Nothing Headphone (1) 在台灣是要賣 9000 塊錢. 你會考慮嗎?
